text: Bitcoin's modest gain is holding above $77k while Ethereum trails slightly, suggesting cautious consolidation rather than fresh conviction in either major asset. The Fear & Greed index sits in moderate greed territory but has retreated 14 points over a week, signaling some pullback in enthusiasm despite today's small gains. Bitcoin dominance at 58.4% and moderate 24-hour volume indicate the market is neither aggressively rotating into alts nor showing broad liquidation pressure—a relatively neutral holding pattern.
